Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for applying and for the quick response yesterday — I'd love to set up a 25-30 minute initial phone screen with one of our hiring managers to talk about your background and the role. To make this easier across time zones, below are three options (listed in both PST and CET):

- Option A: Fri Nov 13, 10:00–10:30 AM PST / Fri Nov 13, 19:00–19:30 CET
- Option B: Mon Nov 16, 08:30–09:00 AM PST / Mon Nov 16, 17:30–18:00 CET
- Option C: Tue Nov 17, 11:30–12:00 PM PST / Tue Nov 17, 20:30–21:00 CET

If none of those work, please share 2–3 30-minute windows that are convenient for you (mornings CET generally work best, I can convert). Also, feel free to attach an updated resume if you have one handy.

If helpful, the interviewer will be Avery Johnson (Engineering Manager). I'll loop in Monica for scheduling and to handle the calendar invite. Once you confirm a slot I’ll send an invite with dial-in details.
